channel.title: Yifan Sun — news
channel.description: Yifan Sun is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie fellow in nonlinear photonics at OPERA-Photonique, ULB, working on cavity solitons and combs in Kerr resonators.

item.title: Invited talk at the MathSEE Symposium in Karlsruhe
item.guid: 2026-09-01-Invited talk at the MathSEE Symposium in
item.description: Invited to speak at MathSEE 2026 in Karlsruhe, Germany — the second invited talk of the year, after the AIMS Conference in Athens.

item.title: APL Photonics accepts our paper on soliton collective-coordinate fluctuations
item.guid: 2026-08-01-APL Photonics accepts our paper on solit
item.description: Collective-Coordinate Fluctuations of Driven-Dissipative Solitons is accepted at APL Photonics, with T. Bunel, F. Bretenaker, S. Coen, S.-P. Gorza and F. Leo.

item.title: Invited talk on pathway-resolved noise channels at AIMS 2026, Athens
item.description: Presented Pathway-Resolved Noise Channels in Temporal Cavity Solitons as an invited talk at the AIMS Conference in Athens, Greece.

item.title: Three contributions at CLEO 2026 in Charlotte
item.description: Two orals, on parametrically driven cavity soliton crystal combs and on phase-coherent picosecond pulse trains at 8 MHz, plus a poster on quantum-limited and coupled soliton noise.

item.title: Two talks at Photonics West 2026 in San Francisco
item.guid: 2026-01-01-Two talks at Photonics West 2026 in San
item.description: Talks on soliton-pursuing dynamics and pump-depletion locking in parametrically driven soliton crystals, and on coupled quantum-limited noise channels in temporal cavity solitons.

item.title: Parametrically driven Kerr temporal soliton crystals in J. Phys. Photonics
item.description: New paper with C. Dupont, E. K. Akakpo, F. De Lucia, G. Semaan, S.-P. Gorza and F. Leo in Journal of Physics: Photonics.

item.title: Transdimensional dynamics of Kerr cavity solitons in Physical Review Research
item.description: A Letter with P. Parra-Rivas, F. Leo, C. Milián and S. Wabnitz on how cavity solitons connect across dimensions, in Phys. Rev. Research 7, L032015.

item.title: Three presentations at CLEO Europe 2025 in Munich
item.description: Orals on the transition from parametrically driven cavity solitons to soliton crystals and on a transdimensional approach to multidimensional solitons, plus a poster on intermodal temporal reflections.

item.title: Intermodal all-optical pulse switching in Nanophotonics
item.description: Co-first-author work with A. C. Sparapani, F. Mangini, M. Ferraro, G. P. Agrawal and S. Wabnitz on temporal reflection and refraction in multimode fibres.

item.title: Best Oral Award at the 2024 Advanced Fiber Laser Conference
item.guid: 2024-11-01-Best Oral Award at the 2024 Advanced Fib
item.description: The talk Stability of coherently-driven multidimensional cavity solitons received a Best Oral Award at AFL 2024 in Changsha, China.

item.title: Invited review on multimode solitons in optical fibres in Photonics Research
item.description: An invited review with P. Parra-Rivas, G. P. Agrawal, T. Hansson, C. Antonelli, A. Mecozzi, F. Mangini and S. Wabnitz, in Photon. Res. 12, 2581.

item.title: Two orals at Photonics Asia 2024 in Nantong
item.guid: 2024-10-01-Two orals at Photonics Asia 2024 in Nant
item.description: Presented a dimension-reduction study of multidimensional solitons in passive Kerr cavities, and pure quartic spatiotemporal solitons in graded-index media.

item.title: Invited talk on variational approaches to light bullets at AES 2024
item.description: Invited presentation on variational approaches for characterizing light bullets in nonlinear optics, given at AES 2024 in Rome, Italy.

item.title: ENLIGHTENS: second Marie Skłodowska-Curie fellowship starts at ULB
item.description: Started a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowship (ENLIGHTENS, grant 101149506) at Université libre de Bruxelles, running to May 2026.

item.title: Robust three-dimensional solitons and breathers in Physical Review Letters
item.description: Phys. Rev. Lett. 131, 137201 reports robust high-order 3D solitons and breathers in driven dissipative systems, realized in a Kerr cavity.

item.title: BEAMLOCKER: first Marie Skłodowska-Curie fellowship starts at Sapienza
item.description: First Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowship (BEAMLOCKER, grant 101064614) began at Sapienza University of Rome, running June 2022 to May 2024.
